name: Almond Water
description: A mysterious liquid that resembles almond-flavored water. It is the most common and important resource in the Backrooms. It can be found in bottles, pools, or dripping from walls. It restores hydration and has mild healing properties.

name: Level Keys
description: Mysterious keys that can unlock doors to specific levels. They are rare and highly sought after.

name: Liquid Pain
description: A dark, viscous liquid that causes extreme pain when consumed. It is the opposite of Almond Water and should be avoided.

name: The Diary
description: A mysterious diary that contains information about the Backrooms. Its contents change depending on who reads it.

name: Cashew Water
description: Similar to Almond Water but with a cashew flavor. It is less common but equally effective.

name: Rose Water
description: A fragrant liquid with a rose scent. It has calming properties and can reduce anxiety.

name: Carpet Fluid
description: A strange liquid that seeps from the carpet in some levels. Its properties are not well understood.

name: Royal Rations
description: A type of food found in the Backrooms. It provides nutrition and is safe to eat.

name: The Black Knight
description: A mysterious sword that can harm entities. It is extremely rare and powerful.

name: The Scarlet Avian
description: A strange bird-like entity that can be found in some levels. It is generally harmless.

name: The Candle
description: A candle that never burns out. It provides light and can be used to navigate dark levels.

name: The Clock
description: A mysterious clock that shows the time in the Backrooms. It may also show the time in the real world.

name: The Device
description: A mysterious device that can be used to communicate with other wanderers. Its range is limited.

name: The Eye of the Forest
description: A mysterious artifact that can see through walls. It is extremely rare and valuable.

name: The Frozen Star
description: A star-shaped crystal that is always cold to the touch. It can freeze objects and entities.

name: The Glitch
description: A glitch in reality that can transport wanderers to random levels. It is dangerous and unpredictable.

name: The Gun of Infinite Ammo
description: A gun that never runs out of ammunition. It is extremely rare and powerful.

name: The Notebook
description: A notebook that contains information about the Backrooms. Its contents are always accurate.

name: The Potion of Healing
description: A potion that can heal injuries and cure diseases. It is rare and valuable.

name: The Reality Checker
description: A device that can determine whether the user is in the Backrooms or the real world.
